hero_text: A new way to explore knowledge: play with your movement, answer challenges and discover scenarios designed for active learning.
hero_create_button: I want to create my own games
levels_title: Which world do you want to enter?
levels_text: Four scenarios that turn every question into an interactive challenge. Pick a level to get started.
level_mars_alt: Planet Mars and a space mission
level_mars_text: Show how much you know about the Solar System.
level_dynos_alt: Volcano and dinosaur in a prehistoric landscape
level_dynos_text: Solve questions about the world of dinosaurs.
level_future_text: Do you feel ready for the questions of the future?
level_ocean_text: Do you know the secrets of the deep sea?
benefits_text: Movement can complement learning and turn practice into a more active experience.
benefit_attention_text: Breaks and physical activities can help children return to their tasks more ready to focus.
benefit_recall_text: Questions, feedback and repetition offer opportunities to retrieve and reinforce what has been learned.
benefit_movement_text: The body takes part in the experience instead of just tapping buttons or watching the screen.
benefit_play_text: Missions, scenarios and clear goals can make practice feel like an adventure.
benefit_feedback_text: Children can check their answers and move on to a new challenge right away.
benefit_together_text: Families and educators can try activities and share what works best for each child.
benefits_note: Physical activity is associated with cognitive benefits in children, but results depend on the activity and the context. This version is a prototype under evaluation, not a clinically validated educational intervention.
beta_title: Help us create the next adventure.

beta_text_2: Tell us what interests you and what you would like children to be able to learn through play.
